metadata.case_name: BISHWAKARMA BHAKTA BAHADUR v. PACIFIC CROWN SECURITY SERVICES LTD AND ANOTHER

source: diagnosed to have suffered from left tripod fracture injury.
Left facial tripod fracture was eventually confirmed.
X-ray revealed that the fracture had healed up without a trace.

injuries.description: incomplete injury to the infra-orbital nerve
source: this was compatible with the involvement of the infra-orbital nerve.

The symptoms of Bishwakarma were consistent with an incomplete injury to the infra-orbital nerve due to fracture orbital floor. This would amount to 2% impairment of the whole person and, given the lapse of time, should be regarded as permanent.

manifestations.description: persistent pain, tenderness and numbness of the left facial tripod
headache, and need to take painkillers
reduced sensation to light touch on the left face below the left eye
mild tenderness over the inferior orbit left side
paresthesia, dysesthesia and diminished sensations in the upper lid and eyebrow
no wound or loss of consciousness as a result of the fall
loss of confidence and low self-esteem

treatments_received: treated and discharged at Princess Margaret Hospital
referral to eye surgeon for further management
follow-up attendance at Princess Margaret Hospital and Tuen Mun Eye Clinic
attendance at Yuen Long Jockey Club General Outpatient Clinic
treatments_future: further treatment for left face pain and numbness on a required basis (Dr Law's opinion)
oral painkillers once every 3 months (per Dr Law)
no further treatment recommended (per Dr Cheng and the neurological experts)

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: loss of confidence and low self-esteem
